data.body:
F01 close blocker

The deterministic close guard requires a provenance continuation that uses at least three U+003B characters and one U+2014 character. The documentation policy bans both code points in tickets. The parser accepts no punctuation-compliant alternative because it reads only the first provenance line, splits fields only on U+003B, and extracts justification only after U+2014. ADR 0061 pins the single-line grammar and states that its deterministic layer does not block. Ticket binary-cobwebby-bittern later promoted the parser to blocking close behavior without an accepted ADR amendment. ADR 0101 states that ADR 0061 remains unaffected. F01 cannot close without violating the approved policy, bypassing the signed close gate, misclassifying external evidence, or changing the parser contract. The recommended repair is a backward-compatible multiline grammar with an ADR amendment. F01 remains in_progress. F06 and F07 remain unreviewed and unclaimed.
